name: Black Android Programming
text:
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck by one of your effects, you may place it into play.)
POWER: Attach to your MP. While attached, your effects that banish cards from the top of your opponent's Life Deck or discard pile have that amount increased by 1. Banish this card when your opponent deals critical damage.

name: Black Astonishing Drill
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Continuous]: Whenever your opponent gains stages during combat, your MP gains the same number of stages.
POWER: Reveal the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Black Recollection Drill
text: [Instant] POWER: Use at the start of your turn. Destroy the top X cards of your Life Deck to destroy the top X cards of your opponent's Life Deck. X = the number of Dragon Balls you control.

name: Black Downward Beam
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
If you have destroyed cards from the top of your opponent's Life Deck this combat, raise your anger 1 level. If your opponent controls no Setups or Drills, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.

name: Black Face Kick
text:
(If this card is placed on top of your Life Deck by a card effect during combat, you may banish it to use a critical damage effect.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Banish the top 5 cards of your discard pile. Banish the top 5 cards of your opponent's discard pile.
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.

name: Black Fist Catch
text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
Choose 3 cards in your opponent's discard pile. Your opponent Rejuvenates those cards. Your opponent chooses 3 cards in your discard pile. Rejuvenate those cards.
(Banish after use.)

name: Black Impact
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Gain 2 stages. Look at the top 3 cards of your Life Deck and place them back in any order.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
HIT: Reveal the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Black Overload
text:
[Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Your MP may pay 3 stages to make this attack's damage unpreventable.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: If this attack dealt critical damage, you may discard a card from your hand to destroy a Setup or Drill.

name: Black Running Guard
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
If that attack was non-Styled, destroy the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Black Sword Attack
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Raise your anger 1 level. You may banish 2 cards with "Sword" in the title from your discard pile to return a Setup or Drill in play to its owner's hand.
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.

name: Black Vaulted Strike
text:
(If this card is discarded or destroyed from your Life Deck, choose a card in your opponent's discard pile and place it on top of his Life Deck.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Name 2 different cards. Reveal the top card of each player's Life Deck. If the named cards were revealed, Rejuvenate 6.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
(Banish after use.)

name: Blue Intimidation
text:
(If you have not drawn a card this combat, you may draw a card when this card enters play during combat.)
POWER: You may discard any number of cards from your hand to draw the same number of cards.
(Banish after use.)

name: Blue Reinforcements
text: [Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Banish an Ally you control to search your Life Deck for an Ally and place it into play at 2 stages above 0. Setups cannot be used this turn.

name: Blue Save
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
POWER: Return an Ally you control to its owner's hand to search your Life Deck for a Styled Setup and place it into play.
(Banish after use.)

name: Blue Seizing Drill
text:
[Continuous]: The Endurance on non-Styled cards cannot be used.
[Instant] POWER: Use after you perform a successful Styled attack. Banish a Setup you control to search your discard pile for a Styled Setup and place it into play.

name: Blue Waiting Drill
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Continuous]: Whenever you Rejuvenate an Ally, destroy the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.
Whenever you play an Ally, Rejuvenate 1.

name: Blue Android Headbutt
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Raise or lower a player's anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: If your opponent advanced a personality level with this card, set an MP's power level to 0.

name: Blue Brush Aside
text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
If you do not control an Ally, search your discard pile for an Ally and play it. If that Ally is in play at the end of combat, banish it.

name: Blue Flying Kick
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Physical attack.
This attack deals +1 stage of damage for each Drill in play.
DAMAGE: AT +4 stages.
HIT: Your opponent cannot use effects to advance or lower 1 or more MP levels this turn.

name: Blue Rehabilitation
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
POWER: If you control less Drills than your opponent, search your Life Deck for a Drill and place it into play. If you control more Drills than your opponent, Rejuvenate 2. Shuffle this card into your Life Deck after use.

name: Blue Swat
text:
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
If you control 1 Ally, you may destroy it to draw a card.
(Banish after use.)

name: Namekian Impending Doom
text: POWER: Attach to a Dragon Ball. While attached, that Dragon Ball gains "[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Discard a Dragon Ball from your hand to destroy a Setup or Drill." Banish this card when a Dragon Ball is banished.

name: Namekian Vanishing Drill
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Continuous]: Non-Styled attacks deal -2 life cards of damage.

name: Namekian Airborne Attack
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Search your discard pile for a non-Styled card and Rejuvenate it.
DAMAGE: AT +4 stages.
HIT: Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Namekian Arm Shield
text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
If you have no cards in your hand, your opponent's attacks deal -2 stages of damage this combat.

name: Namekian Concern
text:
ENDURANCE 4.
POWER: Look at the top 4 cards of your Life Deck. Place 1 of those cards on top of your Life Deck. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your Life Deck in any order.

name: Namekian Multi-Opponent Combat
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
The next time you draw a card this combat, use a critical damage effect.
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.
HIT: Destroy a Drill.

name: Namekian Protective Posture
text:
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
Rejuvenate this card after use.

name: Namekian Robotic Destruction
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
You may shuffle a Dragon Ball you control into its owner's Life Deck. If you do, banish 3 cards from your opponent's discard pile.
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.
HIT: Search your Life Deck for 2 cards and banish them. If you do, Rejuvenate 2.

name: Namekian Team Up
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Attack] Physical attack.
You may shuffle two Allies you control into their owner's Life Deck. If you do, use a critical damage effect.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.

name: Orange Bravado
text:
(If this card enters play during combat, damage from your attacks cannot be prevented this combat.)
POWER: Banish all Drills you control. Your Styled attacks deal +3 stages of damage this combat.

name: Orange Eviction
text: POWER: Attach to one of your Drills. While attached, you cannot stop attacks. Banish this card when your opponent plays an Event and cancel the effects of that Event.

name: Orange Shopping Drill
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Continuous]: Your opponent cannot use effects that banish cards from a discard pile. When this Drill is leaving play, you may banish this card and your discard pile to banish 6 cards from your opponent's discard pile.
note: landscape Drill layout; '(CRD)' stamped below the card (owner annotation) but the filename has no (CRD) flag

name: Orange Welcoming Drill
text: [Continuous]: If you can declare combat, you must do so. Your attacks deal +1 stage of damage. Whenever an opponent's Setup or Drill enters play, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Orange Combined Burst
text:
[Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
HIT: You may destroy up to 3 cards from the top of your Life Deck. If you do, destroy the same number of cards from the top of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Orange Earthquake
text: POWER: Draw a card. Attach this card to your MP. While attached, non-Personality cards that advance an MP 1 or more levels cannot be played nor used. Banish this card when your opponent performs a successful Styled attack.

name: Orange Fierce Attack
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Damage from your Styled energy attacks cannot be prevented this combat.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Raise your anger 2 levels. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Orange Frenzied Assault
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
If you control no Drills, this attack cannot be stopped.
DAMAGE: AT +1 life card.

name: Orange Interference
text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
Your next Styled energy attack this combat has its power stage cost reduced to 0.

name: Orange Withdrawal
text:
(You may banish this card from your hand at the end of combat to search your discard pile for a Drill and place it on top of your Life Deck.)
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Red Reconnaissance Drill
text:
ENDURANCE 3.
[Continuous]: Whenever you banish cards from your discard pile, banish the top card of your opponent's discard pile.

name: Red Android Palm Blast
text:
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck, you may use a critical damage effect.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
DAMAGE: 1 life card.
HIT: Reveal the top 3 cards of your Life Deck. You may place 1 revealed card on the top of your discard pile. Banish the remaining cards.
(Banish after use.)

name: Red Body Block
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
The next non-Styled attack you perform this combat cannot have its damage prevented.

name: Red Departing Shot
text:
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Whenever a Drill leaves play this turn, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Red Disregard
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If this card is banished by one of your effects, raise your anger 1 level.)
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
Banish up to 10 cards from your discard pile.

name: Red Ejection
text:
(If this attack is performed from your discard pile, destroy the top X cards of your opponent's Life Deck. X = the number of Dragon Balls you control.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
DAMAGE: AT +X life cards. X = the number of Dragon Balls in play.

name: Red High Kick
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Reveal the top 4 cards of your Life Deck. You may place 1 Styled [Defense] card revealed into your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your Life Deck in any order.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
note: the inline shield icon is used as a noun ('Styled [Defense] card')

name: Red Lasers
text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Attack] Energy attack costing 4 stages.
At the start of your next action this combat, you may search your Life Deck for a Styled energy attack card and discard it.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.

name: Red Training Burst
text:
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Rearrange the top 5 cards of your discard pile.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Your opponent skips his next action this combat.
(Banish after use.)

name: Red Wallop
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
You may lower your anger by any amount. Your opponent's MP loses X stages. X = the amount of anger you lowered.
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.
HIT: Banish 3 cards from a player's discard pile.

name: Saiyan Targeting
text: POWER: Attach to your MP. While attached and while you control no Drills, the effects of Drills with [Continuous] Powers cannot be used. Banish this card when you change levels.

name: Saiyan Assistance
text:
ENDURANCE 3.
(After your opponent's MP advances 1 or more levels from a card effect, you may banish this card from your hand to lower your opponent's MP 1 level.)
POWER: Lower your opponent's anger X levels. X = your current anger level. Shuffle this card into your Life Deck after use.

name: Saiyan Clash
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
DAMAGE: 1 stage.
HIT: This attack stays in play to be used a second time this combat.

name: Saiyan Club
text:
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
Search your discard pile for a Styled Setup and play it.

name: Saiyan Ferocious Blast
text:
ENDURANCE 3.
(If this card is discarded from your hand during combat, raise your anger 1 level.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: For the remainder of combat, your anger can only be lowered by critical damage effects.

name: Saiyan Severing Punch
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Until the end of your next turn, your opponent cannot gain more than 1 anger from each card effect.
DAMAGE: AT +4 stages.
HIT: Until the end of your next turn, your opponent cannot use effects that advance or lower an MP 1 or more levels.

name: Saiyan Sword Dodge
text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
You may discard a card without "Sword" in the title from your hand. If you do, search your Life Deck for an attack card with "Sword" in the title and place it into your hand.
(Banish after use.)

name: Saiyan Tantrum
text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(If this card is revealed from your hand, you may use a critical damage effect.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
HIT: Rejuvenate 3.

name: Android Arm Breaker
text:
ENDURANCE 3.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Attach to your opponent's MP. While attached, your opponent cannot use effects that advance or lower your opponent's MP 1 or more levels. Banish this card when your opponent deals critical damage.
DAMAGE: 6 stages.

name: Quick Blast
text:
(Heroes only.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Attach to your MP. While attached, [Defense] cards played from the hand are banished after use. While attached at the end of combat, you may shuffle this card into your Life Deck. Destroy this card when your opponent deals critical damage.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards or 4 stages.
note: grey (non-styled) frame; inline shield icon used as a noun

name: Android 13
text:
[Continuous]: Whenever you play a card with "Android" in the title during combat, raise your anger 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
DAMAGE: 4 stages.
HIT: Search your Life Deck for an Ally with "Android" in the title and play it.

name: Android 13
text:
(You cannot win by MPPV if you advance a level with this card's effect.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Banish Android 14 and Android 15 if they are under your control and/or in your discard pile to advance your MP 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Your opponent skips his next action this combat.
DAMAGE: 3 stages.
HIT: Search your Banished Zone for a card with "Android" in the title and Rejuvenate it.

name: Android 13
text:
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Your opponent's MP loses 4 stages. Your opponent skips his first action this combat.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
DAMAGE: 7 stages.
HIT: Your opponent's [Continuous] Powers cannot be used this turn.

name: Android 13
text:
[Continuous]: Your non-Styled attack cards gain "HIT: Your opponent skips his next action this combat."
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
This attack deals +1 stage of damage for each card with "Android" in the title in your discard pile.
DAMAGE: 5 stages.

name: Broly
text:
[Continuous]: After your opponent's MP advances a level, your opponent's MP loses 5 stages.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Raise your anger 1 level. You may reveal 2 attack cards from your hand to banish the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
DAMAGE: 4 stages.

name: Broly
text:
[Continuous]: After your opponent's MP advances a level, your opponent's MP loses 7 stages. Physical attacks performed by this personality deal +2 stages of damage.
POWER: Banish the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. You may reveal 2 attack cards from your hand to banish a Setup or Drill.

name: Broly
text:
[Continuous]: After your opponent's MP advances a level, all of your opponent's personalities lose 7 stages. Physical attacks performed by this personality deal +3 stages of damage.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
You may reveal 2 attack cards from your hand to draw a card.
DAMAGE: 4 stages.

name: Broly
text:
[Continuous]: Your opponent cannot use Endurance. Physical attacks performed by this personality deal +4 stages of damage and their damage is banished.
POWER: Banish the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck. You may reveal 4 attack cards from your hand to banish any amount of Setups, Drills, and Allies.

name: Cooler
text:
[Continuous]: Players cannot use a Setup as their first action in combat.
POWER: You may discard an Energy Combat card from your hand to draw a card. If you do, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck and Rejuvenate 1.

name: Cooler
text:
[Continuous]: After taking damage that was not prevented, raise your anger 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Rejuvenate 2.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: You may discard a card from your hand to draw a card.

name: Cooler
text:
(When you reach this level, search your Banished Zone for a card and Rejuvenate it.)
[Continuous]: After taking damage from an attack, Rejuvenate 1.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Rejuvenate 3.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.

name: Cooler
text:
(You may only use this card's non-[Continuous] power once per game.)
[Continuous]: Whenever a player gains anger, Rejuvenate 1.
POWER: Lower your MP 1 level to Rejuvenate 7 and end combat.
note: Set 6 MP; edge reads 'VILLAIN MP'. PUR 6 here; PZP P143 reprint prints PUR 5

name: Gohan
text:
(You cannot win by MPPV if you advance a level with this card's effect.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your Life Deck for an Ally and play it. If you control 3 or more Allies, advance your MP 1 level.

name: Krillin
text:
[Continuous]: Whenever you perform an attack, your MP may pay 2 stages to have that attack deal +2 stages of damage.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Damage from this attack cannot be modified.
DAMAGE: 4 stages.

name: Master Roshi
text:
(You may use the power of your "Turtle" regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Continuous]: Whenever you banish cards from your opponent's discard pile, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
POWER: Search your Life Deck for an Ally named "Turtle" and play it.

name: Trunks
text:
(Your Drills are not discarded when advancing from this level.)
[Continuous]: Whenever you play a card with "Sword" in the title, Rejuvenate 1.
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your Life Deck for a non-Styled Drill and place it into play.

name: Icarus
text:
(If your MP is Gohan, you may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Continuous]: Your other Allies cannot be destroyed or banished by your opponent's card effects.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
DAMAGE: 1 life card.
HIT: Rejuvenate 1.

text:

[Continuous]: If your MP has "Android" in the title, attacks performed by your MP deal +1 stage of damage for each Ally you control with "Android" in the title.

text:

[Continuous]: Players cannot use effects that would advance an MP 1 or more levels.

(If your MP is Broly, you may use this power regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Continuous]: Effects that end combat cannot be used.
POWER: Reveal your hand. If you revealed at least 2 attack cards, your anger cannot be lowered this combat. Until the end of your opponent's next turn, you cannot win by MPPV.

name: Salza
text:
(If your MP is Cooler, you may use this power regardless of your MP's power stage.)
